## `bb webhook create`

Create a repository webhook

```text
bb webhook create <name> <url> [flags]
```

`--active`
:   Whether the new webhook is active (default true)

`--credentials-password-stdin`
:   Read the endpoint password from stdin (or set BB\_WEBHOOK\_PASSWORD)

`--credentials-username string`
:   Username Bitbucket authenticates to the endpoint with

`--event strings`
:   Webhook event(s) to subscribe to (default \[repo:refs\_changed\])

`--secret-stdin`
:   Read the shared secret from stdin (or set BB\_WEBHOOK\_SECRET)

`--ssl-verification string`
:   Whether Bitbucket verifies the endpoint's TLS certificate, left as the server has it when omitted (one of: true, false)

Inherited from [`bb webhook`](#bb-webhook):

`--repo string`
:   Repository as PROJECT/slug (defaults to BITBUCKET\_PROJECT\_KEY + BITBUCKET\_REPO\_SLUG)

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

**Dry run:** Predicts the outcome from what it can read, without changing anything (predicted)

## `bb webhook test`


## `bb webhook update`

Update a repository webhook

```text
bb webhook update <webhook-id> [flags]
```

`--active string`
:   Active status, unchanged when omitted (one of: true, false)

`--credentials-password-stdin`
:   Read the endpoint password from stdin (or set BB\_WEBHOOK\_PASSWORD)

`--credentials-username string`
:   Username Bitbucket authenticates to the endpoint with

`--event strings`
:   New list of webhook events to subscribe to

`--name string`
:   New name of the webhook

`--no-credentials`
:   Remove the endpoint credentials from the webhook

`--no-secret`
:   Remove the shared secret from the webhook

`--secret-stdin`
:   Read the shared secret from stdin (or set BB\_WEBHOOK\_SECRET)

`--ssl-verification string`
:   Whether Bitbucket verifies the endpoint's TLS certificate, left as the server has it when omitted (one of: true, false)

`--url string`
:   New URL of the webhook

Inherited from [`bb webhook`](#bb-webhook):

`--repo string`
:   Repository as PROJECT/slug (defaults to BITBUCKET\_PROJECT\_KEY + BITBUCKET\_REPO\_SLUG)

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).
